eligibility_tiers.line: Must have a high school unweighted GPA of 3.0 or higher

Students admitted with an unweighted 2.5 to 2.79 GPA may only take one course at their high school in their first semester of dual credit until they have demonstrated academic success (maintained a 2.0+ TMU GPA at the end of the semester).
This special program admits students with an unweighted high school GPA of 2.5 or higher.
